title: Neolix Raises $400M Series E to Push Total Funding Past $1.4B
summary:
The China-based maker of autonomous delivery vehicles Neolix closed a fresh funding round to strengthen its presence in overseas markets. The company secured $400 million in a Series E led by Boyu, which increases its total capital raised to more than $1.4 billion. Neolix will use these proceeds to scale its commercial operations globally and support general growth.

Neolix currently operates a fleet of over 30,000 vehicles across 300 cities in 20 different countries. The latest investment provides the driverless robovan maker with the capital needed to expand its urban delivery services outside of its home market.
